title: Mourning Never Comes
description: Astrid assigns the player their first major Dark Brotherhood contract. Muiri in Markarth wants the bandit Alain Dufont killed for seducing and betraying her, and optionally requests the assassination of Nilsine Shatter-Shield as revenge against the Shatter-Shield family.

base_facts: Leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary near Falkreath.
Oversees contracts and assignments for Brotherhood members.

SPEAK_WITH_ASTRID: Has given the player their first major contract to contact Muiri in Markarth.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: Is satisfied with the completed contract and increasingly suspicious of Cicero's behavior.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Thanks the player for a job well done on their first major contract.
Is increasingly paranoid about Cicero's behavior and insanity.
Asks the player to do her a favor by eavesdropping on Cicero, starting the quest Whispers in the Dark.

base_facts: Works as an assistant at The Hag's Cure apothecary in Markarth.
Performed the Black Sacrament to contact the Dark Brotherhood.

TALK_TO_MUIRI: Wants Alain Dufont dead for seducing her to rob the Shatter-Shield family. Will pay a bonus if Nilsine Shatter-Shield is also killed as revenge.
ALAIN_DEAD: Has rewarded the player for killing Alain Dufont. If Nilsine was also killed, gave Muiri's Ring as a bonus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Showed no remorse over Alain Dufont's death and paid the player for the assassination.
If Nilsine Shatter-Shield was also killed, gave the player leveled gold and Muiri's Ring; otherwise, paid only 100 gold.
If the optional objective was completed, her disposition towards the player increases and she becomes available for marriage.

beats.comment: Astrid gives the player their first major contract after Cicero's arrival at the Sanctuary.
Player contacts Muiri at The Hag's Cure and learns she performed the Black Sacrament.
Muiri explains the targets: Alain Dufont at Raldbthar and optionally Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm.
Optional objective to kill Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm is now available.
Alain Dufont has been killed at Raldbthar. Player must return to Muiri for the reward.
Player has returned to Muiri and been rewarded. Now reports back to Astrid at the Sanctuary.
Quest complete. Astrid directs the player to eavesdrop on Cicero, starting Whispers in the Dark.
